summary: Steep narrow kerb signed no stopping, houses 2-9 m from the edge.

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb at 2, 6 and 9 m along its 30 m length.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow road, little room beside the lane; the kerb is tight to houses and trees.
drivers.convention: A few cars park further east, but this stretch carries no stopping signs.

flags: Signs say No Stopping Any Time
Brisbane River 135 m away; low ground about 6.5 m
sun_shade: Houses to the north shade the kerb in the morning; trees to the south shade the afternoon.
